restaurant_name: กิติคุณคลินิกการแพทย์แผนไทย หัวหิน Thai traditional medicine clinic
text:
I visited this clinic because I had lower back pain from sitting with poor posture for a long time at work. The physiotherapist was excellent. He carefully assessed my condition and treated it step by step. He also used cupping therapy as part of the treatment. I had 3 sessions and start to feel better, less pain.

The doctor was very patient and took the time to explain everything clearly while working on the problem. He answered all my questions and never made me feel rushed. I also appreciated that there was no pressure to buy any packages. Overall, it was a very positive experience. Highly recommended!

text: I was recommended to come to Kitikhun Thai Traditional Medicine Clinic by my lovely friend from the gym.  I have had chronic  lower back pain for about 6 years.  My first consultation plus physiotherapy and cupping took a little over an hour.  First of all, the shooting pain down my right leg amazingly disappeared.  Unbelievable.  The therapist demonstrated some stretches and exercises that I could do at home along with sleeping positions and type of pillow to use.  I will be back for my weekly therapy sessions.  I highly recommend this clinic.

It's been excruciating for three years, especially when I'm sleeping. I can't sleep soundly every night.

Thank you so much, doctor.
I'll help you with recommendations.
